author: claude
summary: Task 007 of the voices-variants-round2 plan: mounts the Voice Lab's Overview content as a standalone, expanded-by-default <details> disclosure ('Voice details') above the remaining tab shell, instead of as one of the 4 tab panels. Field content itself (owned by tasks 003/006) is untouched -- only how OverviewTab is mounted/presented changed.

files.change: Removed the 'overview' entry from `detailTabs` (leaving samples/variants/test -- task 008 will retire the tab shell itself). Rendered `<OverviewTab voice={overviewVoice} onSaved={handleMetadataSaved} />` inside a native `<details open>`/`<summary>Voice details</summary>` block positioned above `<VoiceDetailTabs>`. Changed the controlled `activeTabId` initial state from 'overview' to 'samples' (the new first tab) -- leaving it at 'overview' would have left every tabpanel hidden since no tab with that id exists anymore. No existing Disclosure/Accordion primitive found under frontend/src/components/, so used a bare <details> per the task's fallback guidance.

Added `.voice-lab-page__overview-disclosure`/`__overview-summary`/`__overview-body` rules (bordered card shell + summary row, following the sibling `.live-output-page__section`/`__section-summary` pattern in LiveOutputPage.css) for the new disclosure's layout; no changes to `.voice-detail-tabs*` rules.

Updated the 'renders the voice detail tabs' test: asserts Overview is no longer a `tab` role and Samples is the default active tab. Added a new test asserting the <details> toggles open/closed via its native summary click, that toggling doesn't unmount the Overview fields, and that the Save button's enabled/disabled state is identical whether the disclosure is open or closed (verifies visibility isn't gating Save, per the task's acceptance criteria) -- stops short of asserting a successful save round-trip, see flagged pre-existing bug below.

flow_impact: Fourth task landed in the voices-variants-round2 plan (all four F1.0-related mounting/consolidation tasks 003/004/005/006 already landed). Unblocks task 008 (tab-shell retirement) and task 009 (moving engine-config/test-text into VariantEditor), both of which build on this file's post-007 shape.
flagged_pre_existing_issue: OverviewTab's voice-level fields (attrs/tags/description/languages) are seeded once via `useState(voice?.attributes || {})` at mount and only re-synced by an effect keyed on `voice?.id`. VoiceLabPage's metadata list starts empty and is hydrated asynchronously, so on first paint `overviewVoice` is the untagged fallback ({id, name:id, is_untagged:true}) -- same `id` as the real metadata that arrives moments later. Because the id doesn't change across that fallback-to-real transition, the sync effect never re-fires, so `attrs` (and thus `class`/`gender`/`age`) stays empty forever, permanently disabling the Save button via `requiredMissing`. Verified via a temporary debug assertion during this task (Save button's `disabled` attribute was true, 0 patchVoiceMetadata calls, even for a fully-attributed fixture) then removed from the final test. This predates task 007 (confirmed via `git diff` showing zero changes to OverviewTab.tsx) and is out of this task's scope -- flagging for a follow-up fix rather than fixing here.
